newsitem.title: UK: BT shares reach highest level since March '94.
newsitem.headline: BT shares reach highest level since March '94.

text.p: British Telecommunications Plc (BT) shares climbed to their highest levels since March 1994 on Monday, helped by speculation about talks with Japanese telecoms giant Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp, dealers said.
By 1425 GMT, BT shares were 5-1/2p stronger at 423-1/2 on volume of 11 million, after earlier reaching 427p.
"There's no news doing the rounds today so it must be more speculation about a deal in Japan," one dealer said.
NTT said on Thursday that it had met top BT officials for talks, prompting speculation that the companies could be on the brink of a link-up.
BT played down the significance of the talks but some analysts said they thought a deal could be imminent.
